summary: Szoboszlai is fit. The Hungary manager said so on record, and he trained on Thursday. Gakpo is predicted on the right of the front three. Gravenberch is a doubt, which keeps Mac Allister in the middle.

claims.text: Hungary boss Marco Rossi: 'I didn't see any problem in Dominik.'
Trained on Thursday with Van Dijk, Gravenberch and Isak; formal update at Friday's 1.30pm press conference.
Predicted on the right of the front three, with Szoboszlai and Mac Allister in central midfield.
